invalid:
system:
  crates:
    l1trigger:
      building: '904'
      rack: E1A05
      height: 42
      description: Upper crate in E1A05
      csp_id: 1

  boards:
    serenity127:
      hostname: serenity-s1-0127.cern.ch
      crate: l1trigger
      slot: '4'

  links:
    link_N4N4_[0-11]:
      from: [serenity127, FF_N4_tx, '0-11']
      to: [serenity127, FF_N4_rx, '0-11']
    link_N3N3_[0-11]:
      from: [serenity127, FF_N3_tx, '0-11']
      to: [serenity127, FF_N3_rx, '0-11']
    link_N0N0_[0-11]:
      from: [serenity127, FF_N0_tx, '0-11']
      to: [serenity127, FF_N0_rx, '0-11']
    link_N5N5_[0-11]:
      from: [serenity127, FF_N5_tx, '0-11']
      to: [serenity127, FF_N5_rx, '0-11']
    link_N1N1_[0-11]:
      from: [serenity127, FF_N1_tx, '0-11']
      to: [serenity127, FF_N1_rx, '0-11']
    link_N2N2_[0-11]:
      from: [serenity127, FF_N2_tx, '0-11']
      to: [serenity127, FF_N2_rx, '0-11']
    link_S0S0_[0-11]:
      from: [serenity127, FF_S0_tx, '0-11']
      to: [serenity127, FF_S0_rx, '0-11']
    link_S1S1_[0-11]:
      from: [serenity127, FF_S1_tx, '0-11']
      to: [serenity127, FF_S1_rx, '0-11']
    link_S2S2_[0-11]:
      from: [serenity127, FF_S2_tx, '0-11']
      to: [serenity127, FF_S2_rx, '0-11']
    link_S3S3_[0-11]:
      from: [serenity127, FF_S3_tx, '0-11']
      to: [serenity127, FF_S3_rx, '0-11']

link_settings:
  - default:
    #mode: prbs31 # 2-crate test
    mode: [csp, 128, 256, idle1] # default

  # Mask link -> EMP ch 89
  - to:
      port: 89
    mask: True

contexts:
  # Parameters for all boards
  serenity.processors:
    # Default parameters for all boards - used if not overriden below for specific boards
    parameters:
      # Reset command - clock & TTC source
      reset:source: internal # tcds2

      # Buffer configuration (default = do nothing)
      §configureRxBuffers,configureTxBuffers:
        ids: []
        mode: []
        dataURI: []
        startOffset: []
        dataFile: [{ type: file }] # Dummy datafile for occasions when not used

      # RX MGTs: Configuration and alignment commands (default = do nothing)
      §configureRxMGTs: # KW test v0.5.0
        ids: []
      §alignMGTs:
        ids: []
        target: []

      # TX MGT configuration command (default = do nothing)
      §configureTxMGTs: # KW test v0.5.0
        ids: []

      # Firefly configuration commands (auto-deduce channel list from MGT config)
      §configureFireflyRx,configureFireflyTx:
        ids: auto

  # Parameters
  serenity127.fpga:
    parameters:
      program:package:
        type: file
        # path: https://emp-fwk.web.cern.ch/fw/ci/tags/v0.10.3/pipeline14915303/serenity_s1_vu13p_max-2.tgz
        # LW TCDS v0.3 with Nyquist = 3
        path: https://emp-fwk.web.cern.ch/fw/ci/branches/serenity-s1-nyquist/dbc2ba200df8505e6694d7136628ca0e60486175/pipeline14902358/serenity_s1_vu13p_lw_max-2.tgz

      # RX buffers & MGTs
      #configureRxBuffers,configureRxMGTs,alignMGTs:ids: ['0-123']
      configureRxBuffers,alignMGTs:ids: ['0-123']
      §configureRxBuffers:
        mode: ['Capture']
        dataURI: ['']
        startOffset: [54]
      alignMGTs:target: [54]
      saveRxBuffers:ids: '0-123' #'60-63,64-87'

      # TX buffers & MGTs
      #configureTxMGTs,configureTxBuffers:ids: ['0-123']
      configureTxBuffers:ids: ['0-123']
      §configureTxBuffers:
        mode: ['PlayOnce']
        dataURI: ['file']
        startOffset: [0]
        dataFile:
          - type: file
            path: src/shep/config/input_data.txt
      saveTxBuffers:ids: '0-123'

systme:
  oops: true
